messages.legal-dialog-introduction: A plain-language account of project independence, local data handling, software licences, and the limits of the optional native research bridge.
messages.legal-independent-detail: Republic Observatory is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by 3Division or Hooded Horse.
messages.legal-local-data-detail: Observed saves, settings, catalogues, and analytical databases remain on this computer. The application has no required network service and does not encrypt its current non-credential data stores.
messages.legal-game-ownership-detail: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic, its names, software, formats, and assets belong to their respective owners. The Observatory does not redistribute game assets or claim ownership of them.
messages.legal-no-warranty-detail: The Observatory and optional research companion are provided without warranty. Keep ordinary save backups and stop using a research build if the game or loader behaves unexpectedly.
messages.legal-readonly-contract-title: The companion observes; it does not administer
messages.legal-readonly-contract-detail: The reviewed probe reads a bounded sample of already loaded game memory and writes only its own telemetry file. Its source contract forbids writes to simulation objects, save buffers, game files, Observatory databases, and the network.
messages.legal-native-risk-title: Same-process code is not a sandbox
messages.legal-native-risk-detail: TesmioLoader and its companion DLL run inside the game process. Process instrumentation changes the execution environment even when the probe's intended behaviour is read-only. Republic Observatory does not describe this as operating-system isolation or risk-free operation.
messages.legal-loader-configuration-detail: TesmioLoader is a general modding platform and its normal defaults are not the Observatory's read-only profile. Research use requires save manifests, virtual-file redirection, built-in probes, menu changes, and version bypass to remain off, with the Observatory probe as the only plugin DLL. A supplied verifier must pass before launch.
messages.legal-build-gate-detail: The setup assistant validates an exact reviewed TesmioLoader source identity and invokes only the repository-owned build recipe. It does not download, install, inject, launch W&R, or activate the resulting probe.
messages.legal-research-evidence-title: Samples are research evidence, not biographies
messages.legal-research-evidence-detail: Vector positions and sampled fields are ephemeral observations. They do not establish stable citizen identity, family links, causality, or a longitudinal life history. Those features remain unavailable until separate evidence proves them.
messages.legal-observatory-license-detail: The main Republic Observatory application and its original source remain available under the MIT License in the repository root.
messages.legal-probe-license-detail: The separately built TesmioLoader companion source is licensed GPL-3.0-only because it is designed to compile against the GPL TesmioLoader interface. It is optional and not included in the desktop application binary.
messages.legal-upstream-license-detail: TesmioLoader is third-party GPL software with its own authors, repository, installation, and warranty terms. Republic Observatory does not bundle, silently install, or activate it.
messages.legal-not-advice: This screen documents the project's intended technical and licensing boundaries; it is not legal advice and does not replace review by qualified counsel.
messages.population-probe-description: A bounded companion can expose candidate live fields that saves do not yet reveal. The Observatory validates a fixed telemetry file and reports only aggregate probe status here.
messages.population-probe-read-only: Probe declares no game or save writes
messages.population-probe-read-only-detail: One chained observation hook reads loaded fields after the game renders a frame. The separate observation-only loader configuration must also be verified before launch.
messages.population-probe-ephemeral-detail: Raw probe records are not imported into SQLite or DuckDB in this experiment.
messages.population-probe-no-identity-detail: Samples cannot be joined across dates into a named person or family history.
messages.population-probe-invalid-detail: The telemetry failed the strict read-only, schema, containment, or bounds contract. It was ignored and no Observatory data was changed.
messages.population-probe-missing-detail: The companion remains entirely optional. Ordinary save observation and aggregate Population analytics continue without it.
messages.theme-introduction: Choose an installed, contrast-validated Observatory theme or prepare an inert colour-role document for inspection.
messages.theme-help-text: Theme files contain named colour roles and a bounded chart palette. They cannot contain CSS, scripts, fonts, images, paths, URLs, layouts, or renderer settings.
messages.theme-imported: { $name } was validated and imported without being activated.
messages.theme-removed: { $name } was removed from local theme storage.
messages.theme-remove-confirm: Remove the inactive local theme { $name }? Other revisions remain available.
messages.theme-laboratory-boundary: Edit semantic colours only. The native validator owns every acceptance decision and the host continues to own layout, typography, accessibility, charts, and interaction.
messages.theme-preview-text: Muted explanatory text remains legible on every host-owned surface.
messages.theme-data-only-detail: Themes have no CSS, interface code, renderer access, network access, file access, or executable expressions. Import and selection are separate lifecycle operations.
messages.theme-invalid-structure: The theme document does not satisfy the strict public contract.
messages.theme-install-contrast-blocked: This structurally valid draft does not pass the native contrast assay. It can still be exported for further work, but it cannot be installed.
messages.theme-error-generic: Republic Observatory could not complete the theme operation.
messages.theme-error-too-large: The theme is larger than the 32 KiB safety limit.
messages.theme-error-invalid-manifest: The file is not a valid Republic Observatory theme document.
messages.theme-error-unsupported-version: The theme targets an unsupported schema version.
messages.theme-error-invalid-id: The theme identifier is invalid or uses the reserved Observatory namespace.
messages.theme-error-invalid-metadata: The theme version, name, author, or description is invalid.
messages.theme-error-invalid-colour: Every colour must be a complete #RRGGBB value and the palette must contain three to eight colours.
messages.theme-error-insufficient-contrast: The native contrast assay blocked this theme from installation.
messages.theme-error-duplicate: That exact theme revision or visual appearance is already installed.
messages.theme-error-revision-conflict: That theme ID and version already identify different content. Publish a new semantic version.
messages.theme-error-unknown: That exact theme revision is no longer available.
messages.theme-error-active-remove: Select another theme before removing this active revision.
messages.theme-error-built-in-remove: Built-in Observatory themes cannot be removed.
messages.theme-remediation-foreground-surface: Increase the luminance difference between the foreground role and permitted surfaces.
messages.theme-remediation-divider: Increase the base line contrast used to derive decorative dividers.
messages.theme-remediation-chart-surface: Choose a chart colour that remains visible on chart and tooltip surfaces.
messages.theme-remediation-soft-fill: Adjust the semantic source colour so derived soft fills retain readable text.
messages.theme-remediation-chart-distinction: Increase series distinction; charts still require labels and non-colour encodings.
messages.theme-fallback-message: The selected local theme was unavailable or invalid. Republic Observatory Classic was restored without deleting the local revision.
messages.theme-storage-unavailable: Native theme storage could not be reached. The safe built-in presentation remains in use.
messages.help-language-packs-text: Open Language to install or select an inert .rolanguage.json file. Packs may translate ordinary interface text and missing messages fall back to English.
messages.help-extension-actions-text: Inspection reads a pack without installing it. Import stores a validated revision, while enabling remains a separate deliberate action.
messages.help-extension-lifecycle-text: Separating inspection, validation, and enabling makes content identity and requested calculations reviewable before a pack can contribute charts.
messages.diagnostics-introduction: A bounded English record of important local operations and failures. It is never uploaded automatically.
messages.diagnostics-empty: No diagnostic entries have been recorded.
messages.diagnostics-boundary: The log contains stable operation codes, controlled messages, timings, and aggregate counts. It excludes save contents, definition text, database paths, game paths, usernames, and machine names. Review it before sharing.
messages.diagnostics-clear-confirm: Clear the local diagnostic log? This cannot be undone.
messages.diagnostics-read-failed: Republic Observatory could not read the local diagnostic log.
messages.diagnostics-clear-failed: Republic Observatory could not clear the local diagnostic log.
messages.archive-historical-preview-detail: Every workspace is pinned to this exact immutable save. Later states remain intact but are excluded.
messages.archive-continuation-confirm: Create a new continuation from this save? Later history will remain intact on its existing branch.
messages.archive-context-action-failed: The analytical context could not be changed. No observation was altered.
messages.archive-branch-safety-note: Branches preserve mutually exclusive histories. Selecting one changes analytical context; it never rewrites or deletes another branch.
messages.archive-evidence-explanation: Branching uses supported record identity and exact prefixes—not filenames or file modification order.
messages.archive-heading-description: Inspect every distinct supported state, see when repeated files were deduplicated, and choose the branch used by analytical workspaces.
messages.archive-desktop-required-detail: Launch the desktop program to build a private local archive from observed saves.
messages.archive-empty-detail: Choose a save folder and observe the newest completed save. The first supported history becomes the main timeline.
messages.archive-files-description: Distinct save files observed; repeated reads of the same unchanged file count once.
messages.archive-states-description: Unique statistical payloads retained after content deduplication.
messages.archive-unresolved-description: Histories withheld from a branch because the supported evidence cannot resolve them safely.
messages.archive-shared-records:
{ $count ->
    [one] 1 shared prefix record
   *[other] { $count } shared prefix records
}
messages.archive-rule-successor: An exact prior history prefix continues a branch.
messages.archive-rule-fork: A rollback or incompatible successor starts a separate branch.
messages.archive-rule-ambiguous: Tied or absent evidence remains unassigned.
messages.archive-comparison-unassigned: Unassigned histories cannot be compared: sharing an unresolved label does not establish a common timeline.
messages.archive-comparison-needs-two: Observe at least two distinct states on this branch before calculating a change.
messages.archive-comparison-snapshot-summary: Target save evidence: { $republic } supported republic snapshot fields and { $fields } supported fields across { $cities } city snapshots.
messages.observer-introduction: Connect the local folders the Observatory needs, inspect a completed save manually, or let the read-only automatic observer notice new stable saves.
messages.observer-browser-detail: The browser preview keeps synthetic data. Launch the desktop program to choose local folders and observe a save.
messages.observer-save-folder-detail: Choose the folder containing the game's ZIP saves. Manual observation opens the newest candidate; automatic observation baselines older files, then queues each new candidate. Neither modifies a save.
messages.observer-game-folder-detail: Choose the SovietRepublic folder, or its media_soviet folder, so installed game vocabulary can remain separate from interface translations.
messages.observer-save-candidates:
{ $count ->
    [one] 1 ZIP save found
   *[other] { $count } ZIP saves found
}
messages.observer-game-vocabularies:
{ $count ->
    [one] 1 installed language source found
   *[other] { $count } installed language sources found
}
messages.observer-no-observation: No save has been observed yet.
messages.observer-imported: The newest save was observed and stored locally.
messages.observer-duplicate: That statistical payload was already observed; no duplicate history was stored.
messages.observer-automatic-detail: While the desktop program is open, native file events wake the Rust recorder and periodic reconciliation protects against missed events. It waits for an unchanged file window and retries temporary incomplete saves without disturbing earlier observations.
messages.observer-automatic-needs-folder: Choose a save folder before automatic observation can begin.
messages.observer-automatic-watching: Watching for new stable ZIP saves.
messages.observer-automatic-retrying: Retry { $attempt } for { $file }; the candidate may still be incomplete.
messages.observer-automatic-failed: Could not safely observe { $file }. A changed or newer candidate will be reconsidered automatically.
messages.save-safety-observer-boundary: The observer opens the ZIP and streams stats.ini in place. It does not extract, rename, rewrite, move, or delete the save.
messages.save-safety-private-paths: Full folder paths remain in the app's private local database and are never placed in charts or extension data.
messages.coverage-game-vocabulary-identities: Installed .btf language-file identities are catalogued locally. Their text is not decoded, copied, or used as calculation identity in this slice.
messages.error-observer-invalid-directory: That folder is unavailable. Choose an existing local folder.
messages.error-observer-invalid-game-directory: That folder does not contain media_soviet. Choose the SovietRepublic installation folder or media_soviet itself.
messages.error-observer-save-directory-not-config: Choose a save folder before observing a save.
messages.error-observer-no-save-candidate: No ZIP save was found in the configured folder.
messages.error-observer-invalid-save-candidate: The newest candidate is not a usable ZIP save.
messages.error-observer-save-changed: The save changed while it was being read. Wait for saving to finish, then try again.
messages.error-observer-invalid-archive: The newest save archive could not be read safely.
messages.error-observer-missing-stats: The save contains no usable stats.ini payload.
messages.error-observer-duplicate-stats: The save contains more than one stats.ini payload, so it was rejected as ambiguous.
messages.error-observer-stats-too-large: The stats payload exceeds the observer's safety limit.
messages.error-observer-invalid-encoding: The stats payload is not supported plain text.
messages.error-observer-line-too-long: A stats line exceeds the observer's safety limit.
messages.error-observer-unsupported-format: This explicit stats format is not supported by the current parser.
messages.error-observer-malformed-history: The receiver history is structurally ambiguous and was not imported.
messages.error-observer-malformed-snapshot: A current or city snapshot is structurally ambiguous, so the save was not imported.
messages.error-observer-receiver-unavailable: No usable receiver history was found in this save.
messages.error-observer-storage-unavailable: The private local observation database is unavailable.
messages.error-observer-unknown-branch: That timeline branch is no longer available. Refresh the archive and choose another branch.
messages.error-observer-incompatible-comparison: Those observations are not on one resolved branch and cannot be combined into a change.
messages.error-observer-same-comparison: Choose two different observed states to calculate a change.
messages.error-observer-unknown-observation: One of those observations is no longer available. Refresh the archive and choose again.
messages.error-observer-unknown: The save observer could not complete this request.
messages.monitor-sidebar-note: Near-live means immediately after a completed save becomes stable. The Observatory does not inspect game memory or claim frame-live telemetry.
messages.monitor-near-live-detail: Native file events wake the recorder; a periodic reconciliation pass protects against missed operating-system notifications.
messages.monitor-heading-description: See whether new saves are being noticed, stabilised, recorded, and retained without confusing an absent game save with an observer failure.
messages.monitor-desktop-required: Native monitoring is unavailable in the browser preview
messages.monitor-desktop-required-detail: Launch the desktop program to watch a local save folder and retain its recording ledger in SQLite.
messages.monitor-recorder-native: Rust-owned service; independent of the displayed workspace.
messages.monitor-queue-detail: Discovered, settling, reading, or safely retrying.
messages.monitor-attention-detail: Terminal failures remain visible for diagnosis.
messages.monitor-no-core-blocking: Earlier observations and other workspaces remain available.
messages.monitor-service-description: A native folder event requests a scan. The recorder then verifies a stable identity, reads the archive in place, and commits the result and its provenance locally.
messages.monitor-pulse-description: Movement and observation cadence for the selected resolved timeline. Values remain tied to completed saves and actual in-game dates.
messages.monitor-comparison-unavailable: The two latest selected-branch observations could not be compared safely.
messages.monitor-largest-interval-note: A long interval may mean the game did not save; it is not automatically an observer failure.
messages.monitor-classified-note: The denominator is the four supported receiver classes, not total population.
messages.monitor-city-scope-note: { $fields } supported scalar facts retained across those city scopes.
messages.monitor-branch-watch-note: { $unresolved } unresolved states remain outside analytical timelines.
messages.monitor-unverified-statistics-note: Current and city scalar facts are retained faithfully, but demographic fields are not shown as rates until their accumulation window and denominator are verified.
messages.monitor-chart-cadence-description: Elapsed in-game days between consecutive retained states on the selected branch. This measures observation spacing, not desktop wall-clock polling.
messages.monitor-chart-receiver-change-descriptio: Signed citizen-count change between the two latest distinct states on the selected resolved branch.
messages.monitor-ledger-description: Inspection, retries, deduplication, and terminal outcomes remain separate. Full folder paths are deliberately absent.
messages.monitor-ledger-empty: No save candidate has entered the ledger
messages.monitor-ledger-empty-detail: Enable automatic observation after choosing a save folder. Existing older files are baselined rather than silently replayed.
messages.monitor-candidate-safe-detail: The ledger records bounded file identity and processing evidence without exposing the configured folder path.
messages.monitor-no-candidates: No candidate evidence has been recorded yet.
messages.monitor-boundary-app-open: The native service runs while the desktop program is open.
messages.monitor-boundary-no-memory: No process-memory reading or game injection.
messages.monitor-boundary-no-save-write: No save creation, modification, movement, or deletion.
messages.language-introduction: English (Australia) is the canonical source. Community packs can translate ordinary interface messages, with per-message English fallback.
messages.language-community-files-detail: Versioned .rolanguage.json text data, validated locally before installation.
messages.language-installed-status: Installed { $name }. Review it in the list before selecting it.
messages.language-remove-title: Remove this locally installed language pack
messages.language-exported-status: Exported { $name } as a portable language-pack file.
messages.language-no-community-packs: No community language packs are installed.
messages.security-language-boundary: Community packs cannot replace save-safety, evidence, coverage, causality, synthetic-data, extension-permission, security, destructive-action, or error messages.
messages.security-language-storage-native: Desktop authority: validated by Rust and stored in the app-local SQLite database.
messages.security-language-storage-unavailable: Desktop language storage is unavailable. Built-in English remains active; no community pack changes will be accepted until local storage recovers.
messages.security-language-storage-preview: Browser preview: stored only in this browser profile. The desktop application uses Rust and SQLite instead.
messages.destructive-language-remove-confirm: Remove the locally installed language pack “{ $name }”? English (Australia) will become active if this pack is selected.
messages.error-language-manifest-too-large: That language pack is larger than the 256 KiB safety limit.
messages.error-language-invalid-json: That file does not contain valid JSON.
messages.error-language-invalid-manifest: That file is not a valid Republic Observatory language-pack manifest.
messages.error-language-unsupported-version: That language pack targets an unsupported schema or source-catalogue version.
messages.error-language-invalid-identifier: That language-pack identifier is invalid or reserved by Republic Observatory.
messages.error-language-invalid-metadata: That language pack contains invalid locale, name, author, or direction metadata.
messages.error-language-invalid-message: That language pack contains an unknown, malformed, or incompatible message.
messages.error-language-protected-message: Community language packs cannot replace protected Observatory messages.
messages.error-language-storage-unavailable: Republic Observatory could not read or save its local language settings.
messages.error-language-unknown-pack: Choose a language pack that is currently installed.
messages.error-language-built-in-remove: The built-in English catalogue cannot be removed.
messages.synthetic-briefing-sidebar-note: This interface uses synthetic values. Connected observations will retain source, coverage, parser version, and actual game date.
messages.synthetic-no-real-save-values: No displayed number was read from a real save.
messages.briefing-heading-eyebrow: Central planning brief · latest distinct state
messages.briefing-heading-description: Outcomes first, followed by the movement and evidence that explain them.
messages.briefing-material-description: Each cell is a resource index and a route into its complete evidence dossier.
messages.material-note-crops: Domestic supply covers most recorded demand.
messages.material-note-wood: No recorded imports in the selected window.
messages.material-note-oil: Low external exposure in the preview basket.
messages.material-note-mechanical: Improving, but still material to vehicle production.
messages.material-note-steel: Construction demand remains the main recorded use.
messages.material-note-bricks: A low but non-zero import bridge remains.
messages.material-note-prefab: Exposure rose during the current building pulse.
messages.material-note-food: Small imports provide a consumer reserve.
messages.material-note-electronics: Consumer supply inherits upstream component risk.
messages.material-note-fuel: Exposure fell across the recent observation window.
messages.material-note-power: External supply is a small recorded share.
messages.material-note-mixed-waste: Factory generation is the leading source in the preview.
messages.material-note-hazardous-waste: Growth exceeds the illustrative baseline range.
messages.briefing-dispatch-body: Fuel and steel exposure fell across the comparison window, while chemicals and electronic components remain the two largest constraints. The industrial plan is behind its scheduled path for a second consecutive quarter. Demographic balance remains positive, although city coverage is not represented in this preview.
messages.attention-plan-title: Industrial plan is 3.1 points behind schedule
messages.attention-plan-detail: The shortfall widened in the last two plan quarters.
messages.chart-summary-gap-count:
{ $count ->
  [one] 1 marked observation gap.
 *[other] { $count } marked observation gaps.
}
messages.chart-sankey-summary: Total source flow: { $sources }. Total terminal flow: { $sinks }. Largest flow: { $largestSource } to { $largestTarget }, { $largestValue }.
messages.chart-material-flow-description: Where does the synthetic steel supply originate, and which uses account for it during one planning window? Ribbon width represents flow volume in one common unit.
messages.chart-material-flow-takeaway: Domestic output supplies most of the illustrative demand, while imports support the shared pool and 6 units remain explicitly unaccounted rather than being labelled as waste or loss.
messages.chart-material-flow-source: Synthetic material-flow laboratory · no save or catalogue values
messages.production-route-description: Select a catalogued recipe and scale its recorded input and output coefficients around one chosen output. Ribbons use only the target output's comparable basis; other requirements remain visible separately.
messages.production-route-synthetic-note: The desktop catalogue is unavailable in this preview, so the established synthetic steel-allocation proof remains below. Configure the game directory in the desktop application to inspect source-backed recipes.
messages.production-route-no-catalogue: A published definition catalogue is required before production routes can be inspected.
messages.production-route-error: This production route could not be read from the current catalogue.
messages.production-route-no-routes: No catalogued production routes match this search.
messages.production-route-status-too-complex: Too many relations for a bounded diagram
messages.production-route-status-missing-quantity: One or more quantities are unavailable
messages.production-route-status-invalid-quantity: One or more quantities are invalid
messages.production-route-status-missing-unit: One or more unit bases are unavailable
messages.production-route-status-no-comparable-in: No input shares the target output basis
messages.production-route-status-duplicate-endpoi: The route has ambiguous repeated endpoints
messages.production-route-boundary: These are theoretical definition coefficients, not observed throughput, rated capacity, inventory movement, or a mass-balance claim.
messages.production-route-overlay-boundary: Planning Overlay v1 can alter typed properties but not recipe relationships; the active overlay revision is pinned for reproducibility and does not change these ribbons.
messages.production-route-chart-description: Which recorded inputs and outputs accompany a target coefficient of { $target } { $unit } for { $route }? Ribbon width is proportional only within this compatible definition basis.
messages.production-route-chart-takeaway: The largest recorded input coefficient at this target is { $resource }: { $quantity } { $unit }.
messages.production-route-chart-takeaway-none: No comparable input coefficient is available for this route.
messages.production-route-table-fallback: The exact source relations remain available below without assigning misleading ribbon widths.
messages.production-route-auxiliary-description: These relations scale with the selected recipe quantity but use a different or unavailable basis. They remain outside the ribbons so unlike quantities are never compared by width.
messages.production-route-evidence-description: Every row remains visible whether or not the relations qualify for a Sankey diagram.
messages.production-route-basis-primary-reason: Included because it shares the selected output basis.
messages.production-route-basis-different-unit: Excluded from ribbon width because its basis differs from the selected output.
messages.production-route-basis-missing-unit: Excluded from ribbon width because no verified basis is recorded.
messages.chart-plan-description: Cumulative, target-normalised progress. The preview shows how actual observations remain separate from the scheduled path.
messages.chart-import-description: Resource-level recorded reliance, kept separate by material rather than hidden inside one composite score.
messages.synthetic-source-plan-preview: Synthetic plan preview · no save connected
messages.synthetic-source-material-basket: Synthetic material basket · production coverage illustrative
messages.evidence-audience-unavailable: Potential and current listeners and viewers remain unavailable from supported saves.
messages.evidence-broadcast-sidebar-note: Receiver classes are available as plain-text save facts. Station reach, ratings, staffing, and outcomes shown here are synthetic research concepts.
messages.evidence-annotations-not-evidence: Hypotheses and player changes remain annotations, not manufactured evidence.
messages.coverage-dependency-experimental: Dependency values are experimental until resource coverage is validated.
messages.synthetic-no-station-telemetry: No station telemetry has been decoded or loaded.
messages.evidence-broadcast-mixed-detail: The receiver ladder comes from the selected save. Audience, programme, influence, outcome, notebook, bulletin, and station values remain visibly synthetic research concepts.
messages.broadcast-heading-description: Treat radio and television as measurable public institutions—without mistaking a handsome correlation for a confession.
messages.synthetic-programme-formulation-note: Six game-facing preferences shown as a formulation, not a prescription. Values are synthetic and do not claim the game applies a linear mixture.
messages.causality-comparison-warning: Compare aligned pre/post windows, contemporaneous changes, coverage, and plausible lags before attributing any citizen outcome to broadcasting.
messages.notebook-hypothesis-education: A steadier education block precedes higher loyalty without depressing happiness.
messages.notebook-hypothesis-television: Television adoption is widening the reachable evening audience.
messages.notebook-intervention-cohort: No schedule change; receiver cohort watch
messages.broadcast-bulletin-title: Television advances; the wireless remains indispensable
messages.causality-bulletin-body: Television is the largest receiver class in this synthetic observation, while radio still accounts for one quarter of classified citizens. The illustrated education and propaganda schedule coincides with a gradual loyalty rise, but the Ministry declines to award the transmitter a medal until decoded audience evidence and a longer comparison window arrive.
messages.synthetic-station-values-warning: Displayed station values demonstrate the intended inspector only. They are not save facts and are not estimates safe for administration.
messages.chart-receiver-description: Synthetic 100% composition of citizens classified as having no receiver, radio, television, or computer. The denominator is the four recorded classes, not total population.
messages.evidence-chart-receiver-description: Observed 100% composition of citizens classified as having no receiver, radio, television, or computer. Records use their actual in-game dates; the denominator is the four recorded classes, not total population.
messages.synthetic-source-receiver-pack: Synthetic built-in mirror of Receiver Adoption Laboratory · independent of pack enablement
messages.evidence-receiver-observation-descriptio: Exact source identity and parser coverage for the observed receiver ladder. Full private folder paths are deliberately absent.
messages.evidence-format-profile-note: Unmarked legacy stats.ini grammar observed against W&R 1.1.1.9; the archive does not self-declare a game version.
messages.coverage-no-fields-inferred: Missing or malformed inputs stay unavailable; the observer never fills a receiver class to preserve a stack.
messages.chart-audience-description: Illustrative radio and television reach. Station audience telemetry is not decoded and remains a binary-research candidate.
messages.synthetic-source-audience: Synthetic interface concept · binary station evidence unavailable
messages.chart-influence-description: Signed, illustrative effect directions for the selected programming formulation. These are neither calibrated game coefficients nor causal findings.
messages.causality-chart-outcomes-description: Annotated trends around a synthetic broadcast change. Movement after the event is an association for investigation, not proof that broadcasting caused it.
messages.synthetic-source-outcomes: Synthetic aligned status observations and player annotation
messages.extension-permission-concept-only: This is an interface concept for a schema proof. It cannot import, install, enable, or execute an extension.
messages.extension-permission-no-manager-host: No extension manager or executable plugin host exists in this pass.
messages.security-extension-host-boundary: The host supplies trusted observations, calculations, provenance, and rendering. Packs describe what they need; they do not bring their own little web browser.
messages.extensions-stack-chart-label: Illustration of a 100 percent stacked chart
messages.extension-permission-host-resolves-chart: Host resolves observations, evidence, colours, motion, and chart options.
messages.security-extension-unknown-fields: Unknown fields fail validation; plain strings are never rendered as markup.
messages.extensions-inspect-description: Read identity, contents, and requested metrics.
messages.extensions-validate-description: Check schema, semantics, compatibility, and content identity.
messages.extension-permission-enable-description: A distinct future user choice; no control is implemented here.
messages.security-model-plugin-boundary: Reserved for a demonstrated statistical model that exceeds the declarative operation catalogue. Any future program runs out of process and receives bounded normalised observations—not saves, binaries, SQLite, parser internals, paths, or rendering access.
messages.extensions-validator-description: The Rust host is the authoritative validator. Ajv independently proves development conformance and keeps examples honest.
messages.extensions-format-vocabulary: Format and data vocabulary evolve independently.
messages.extensions-runtime-compatibility: Future executable compatibility will be explicit.
messages.security-isolation-caveat: Isolation reduces coupling; it is not a security boundary by itself.
messages.extensions-boundary-note: Analysis Packs receive only host-owned normalised observations. Importing a pack does not enable it.
messages.extensions-manager-description: Inspection, import, enablement, rollback, export, and removal are separate local operations.
messages.extensions-import-controls: Analysis Pack inspection and import controls
messages.extensions-import-separation: Inspection does not install or enable a pack.
messages.extensions-action-failed: The Analysis Pack operation could not be completed.
messages.extensions-inspection-valid: The pack passed the authoritative schema and semantic checks. You may now import it.
messages.extensions-inspection-invalid: The pack was rejected during inspection: { $code }.
messages.extensions-file-too-large: The selected pack exceeds the 512 KiB safety limit.

messages.extensions-removed-notice: { $name } was removed from the local library.
messages.extensions-library-description: Each pack is validated before storage. Importing a new revision does not silently change the enabled revision.
messages.extensions-library-empty: No Analysis Packs are installed. Inspect the included Receiver Adoption Laboratory to begin.
messages.extensions-analysis-description: The host evaluates each enabled pack against the selected branch without joining branches or filling unavailable observations.
messages.extensions-analysis-empty: Enable an installed pack and observe a compatible save to produce its charts.
messages.extensions-authoritative-validator: The Rust desktop host is the authoritative validator and evaluator. Development schema tests independently keep the public examples conformant.
messages.extensions-enable-description-live: Enabling selects one immutable revision and permits only its declared host-evaluated calculations and chart templates.
messages.catalogue-boundary-note: The host exposes bounded facts and dossiers. Interface code never receives SQL, database paths, or complete installed definition files.
messages.catalogue-heading-description: Source-qualified installed definitions, effective planning values, and reproducible warehouse generations.
messages.catalogue-progress-stalled: No progress update has arrived for 15 seconds. The operation may be waiting on storage; consult Diagnostics for its last completed phase.
messages.catalogue-progress-error-code: The refresh stopped with diagnostic code: { $code }
messages.catalogue-action-failed: The catalogue action could not be completed.
messages.catalogue-setup-title: Configure the game folder to begin
messages.catalogue-setup-description: The catalogue will discover local base-game, DLC, Workshop, and WIP definitions without uploading or copying game assets.
messages.catalogue-repair-unavailable: Repair and maintenance planning is unavailable because no explicit source field or verified rule was found for this definition.
messages.catalogue-overlay-description: Profiles preserve installed facts and add explicit player assumptions with reasons and revision preconditions.
messages.catalogue-valid-overlay: Valid inert overlay. Import remains separate from activation.
messages.catalogue-recorder-independent: Save recording remains available if this analytical warehouse needs attention.
messages.catalogue-auto-cost-warning: Automatic construction coefficients remain unresolved rules until the game's conversion is verified; they are never displayed as final material quantities.
messages.observer-workshop-folder-detail: Optional fallback when the Steam installation cannot be discovered automatically. Choose the folder containing app 784150 Workshop item folders.
messages.observer-workshop-private: The full selected path remains private app-local configuration.
messages.compatibility-description: A reviewed inert profile maps version-sensitive W&R names and fixed layouts into stable Observatory facts. One app-local override may replace those mappings and narrowly scope unusual mod vocabulary to an exact Workshop or WIP package.
messages.compatibility-coverage: { $markers } markers · { $fields } fields · { $operations } definition operations · { $layouts } binary layouts · { $scopes } mod scopes
messages.compatibility-scope-guidance-matched: The installed definition content matches the acknowledged revision exactly.
messages.compatibility-scope-guidance-dormant: This mapping remains inactive because its exact Workshop or WIP source is not installed.
messages.compatibility-scope-guidance-updated: The mapping remains active by explicit policy, but the installed definitions changed after the last acknowledgement.
messages.compatibility-scope-guidance-conflict: The new catalogue generation was refused. Review the changed definitions and update the acknowledged hash before refreshing again.
messages.compatibility-created: A strict starter override was created and activated.
messages.compatibility-reloaded: Compatibility mapping reloaded. Invalid edits never replace the last valid profile.
messages.compatibility-reinterpreted: The newest save was interpreted under the active profile without changing its raw bytes.
messages.compatibility-no-editor: Edit the JSON file with your preferred text editor. It cannot contain scripts, SQL, paths, URLs, expressions, callbacks, or rendering options.
messages.compatibility-change-note: A mapping change creates a new immutable interpretation; it never rewrites an earlier observation.
messages.reinterpretation-failed-note: The existing observation remains available; inspect Diagnostics before trying again.
messages.population-sidebar-boundary: Every displayed value is an exact save-sampled fact. The Observatory does not construct individual biographies until a stable citizen identity and the requested life fields are independently proven.
messages.population-evidence-banner-detail: Current and city snapshots are supported; individual identity, family links, and life events remain unavailable.
messages.population-heading-description: Compare exact save snapshots on the selected branch without joining later history, interpolating missing observations, or upgrading source counters into unverified rates.
messages.population-desktop-required-detail: Open the desktop application and observe a save before using the Population laboratory.
messages.population-no-observations-detail: The parser has not stored a republic snapshot for the selected analytical context.
messages.population-direct-source-count: Direct source count at the exact selected observation.
messages.population-no-rate-denominator: No rate is inferred because a validated exposure denominator is unavailable.
messages.population-city-identifiers-neutral: Numeric source identifiers remain neutral until city names are proven.
messages.population-window-unverified-detail: These are recorded counters at each save. Lines show sampled values only; they are not births, deaths, migration, or escape rates and are not a causal model.
messages.population-city-description: Inspect the five supported counters for one numeric city source at the selected save. City names, resident population weights, and comparison rates are not yet available.
messages.population-life-description: The worker table is regular enough to research, but current evidence cannot follow one fictional citizen safely from save to save.
messages.population-life-help-text: Rows can move between saves and visible names are neither unique nor stable identifiers. Publishing a timeline now could merge different citizens or split one citizen into several false lives.
messages.population-gate-record-layout-detail: A bounded fixed-width candidate table and name-token fields were observed, but the full record contract is not validated.
messages.population-gate-stable-identity-detail: Array position changes between saves and a safe persistent citizen key has not been established.
messages.population-gate-family-links-detail: The screenshot demonstrates game behaviour, but the underlying relationship fields and identifiers have not been verified in the save.
messages.population-gate-life-events-detail: Moves, orphanage and prison transitions, education, work, migration, escape, and death remain disabled rather than inferred.
messages.population-head-exact-note: All charts and city facts stop at this analytical head. Later states on the branch are excluded during historical preview.
messages.population-no-source-ledger: No population source fields are available for this context.
messages.population-boundary-save-fact: Direct values retain source field and line evidence.
messages.population-boundary-no-interpolation: Missing observations are never silently interpolated.
messages.population-boundary-no-causality: Counter comparisons are descriptive, never causal.
messages.population-boundary-no-biographies: Individual stories remain unavailable without stable identity.
messages.population-chart-status-description: Direct republic counts at each included save. Categories are shown separately and are not assumed to form a complete or mutually exclusive population total.
messages.population-chart-movement-description: Birth, death, escape, and immigration source counters sampled at each save. Their accumulation window is not yet validated, so no interval flow or rate is calculated.
messages.population-chart-education-title: Education counts at the selected head
messages.population-chart-education-description: Direct no-, basic-, and higher-education source counts. The categories are not normalised into shares without a validated denominator contract.
messages.population-chart-city-description: Direct movement-counter values for one numeric city source at the exact analytical head.
messages.error-observer-invalid-compatibility: The compatibility profile is invalid. The last valid mapping remains active.
messages.error-observer-binary-compatibility: A declared fixed binary layout did not safely match this save.
messages.error-observer-critical-task-busy: A save reinterpretation is already running.
messages.error-observer-warehouse-write-limit: The analytical workload exceeded its safe warehouse write limit. Save recording remains available; inspect Diagnostics for details.
messages.error-catalogue-compatibility-conflict: An exact mod compatibility scope no longer matches the installed definition content. The previous catalogue remains active; review the scope before acknowledging the new hash.
messages.research-setup-entry-cue-detail: Prepare the optional read-only Tesmio research probe through a bounded, locally validated assistant.
messages.research-setup-introduction: A guided preflight and local build for the separate Tesmio research companion. Each prerequisite is checked before the build control becomes available.
messages.research-setup-boundary-detail: The assistant does not download sources, install a loader, inject code, start W&R, or run the probe. Ordinary save monitoring never depends on this experiment.
messages.research-setup-notice-title: Review and accept the research notice
messages.research-setup-notice-detail: Acceptance records this notice revision locally and may be revoked. It is not consent to install or execute anything inside the game.
messages.research-setup-checkout-detail: Choose an existing local checkout. The host accepts only the two reviewed headers with their exact bounded SHA-256 identities.
messages.research-setup-checkout-reviewed: The selected checkout matches the reviewed TesmioLoader source identity.
messages.research-setup-prerequisites-detail: The Observatory checks its repository-owned probe source and the local Microsoft C++ build toolchain. It does not install missing tools.
messages.research-setup-build-detail: The host runs one fixed repository build recipe, bounds its output, redacts private paths from the log, and records the resulting content hash.
messages.research-setup-build-cue-detail: All prerequisites are satisfied. This creates a local DLL artifact only; it does not install or run it.
messages.research-setup-build-success: The probe was built and its bounded artifact identity was verified.
messages.research-setup-guidance-replayed: The Population entry point and build-control cues will appear again.
messages.research-setup-progress-error: The build stopped safely ({ $code }). No probe was installed or run.
messages.research-setup-error: The research setup action could not be completed ({ $code }).
